user_message: I'm just so tired of it all, always being stepped on, always being ignored, always being used. Maybe I'm just not good enough, maybe I'm just not worthy of being heard, of being seen. Maybe I'm just a joke, a joke to everyone. And even if I somehow managed to stand up for myself, even if I somehow managed to speak out, it would just be a momentary distraction, a brief reprieve before they come for me again, before they crush me again.
